0172 'brang bcas/ phyi mo dung 132120567 phyur rjes 'brang bcas/ a dhwa 'phred zhe gcig steng 'og pa sa bzhi rjes 4172653 'brang dang bcas pas mchis pa'i nang gsel naṣṭa badzra sogs dang*/ u dhiṣṭa brtse nus pa bsam mi khyab bdag skyabs mchog rin chen gsum gyi dngos// gzhar yang mi 'gyur gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo mngon gyur kyang*// ༄༅// mnotpādanapraṇidhyaṃdzaitasarbalakṣaṇānulomorūpakaṃ prayatstshantusarbataḥpurṇogaterbipākabodhikālyāṇottam// ༄༅// thugs bskyed smon lam rjes su mthun gzugs rgyal sras sems dpa'i mtshan nyid dag /kun nas rdzogs pa 'gro ba byang chub smin byed bla mas dge legs stsol// phul byung byang chub snying por thugs bskyed g.yar dam bcas pa'i rtsa ba brling*// bgrang yas bskal par bsags pa'i zab dang rgya che'i tshogs zung yal 'dab rgyas// spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dpag yas snye ma bye ba g.yur du za// lhar bcas skye dgu'i ston mchog thub dbang dpag bsam ljon pa lan brgyar 'dud// grangs med skye nas skye bar ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gzhung lugs ni// gang la ma sbyangs lhag ma 'di snyam dogs pa'i dpyangs thag yod ma yin// gang phyir gnyis su med gsung bka' dang dgongs 'grel bzhed pa phra zhib gnas// yang dag smra la bsnyengs bral spobs mtho sa skya'i dad sgrol rnam pa lnga// lham mer gsal lo mi ltung phreng khrod 'bras ldan dus kyi kun phan 'od// sngo bsangs dbyar skyes rkang 'thung 'khrigs dbus u dum wā ra'i me tog tshal// mkhas btsun grub pa'i mi 'gyur phreng snyan bstan 'dzin skyes chen mang byon yang*// kun mkhyen zhal lung dri med kyis bsngags rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang mtshungs su// dpal ldan ngaṃg gi dbaṃng phyug grub pa gang gi gsang gsum yon tan mtha'// mnyam nyid gzhal ba'i ngo mtshar lang tsho nga la mchis snyam kun gsal dga' mi rgyags mi 'tshal// dpal stug dbang po kunaṃ du dgaṃ' bskyed bloṃ groṃs dar bab 'jam dpal dbyangs// rdzogs sangaṃs rgyaṃs bstaṃn 'doms pa'i rgyalaṃ po dge mtshaṃn ldan pa des kyang 'gran// brtse dang byang chub sems rgyud 'byangs la rjes su chags pa'i mtsho ldan ma// longs spyod 'khor lo'i bsti gnas la dgyes sde snod gsum dang rgyud chen bzhi'i// dgongs don rnam 'grel tshangs dbyangs snyan dngags dam pa'i glu dbyangs len no zhes// phyogs bral gdul bya'i yid 'phrog e waṃ gdan rabs rim pa gang byon dang*// rgyal ba'i dbang pos bshad sgrub dar bar lung gis rab bsngags bod chen gyi// nor 'dzin thig ler tha gru yangs par chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sde// 'dzad med 'byung gnas gcig tu dge bcu'i bka' khrims rtsibs stong 'khor lo ring po'i lam// yong ye bgrod la 'gog byed dgra sdes co 'dris dben pa'i rgyal khab cher// chos kyi 'od stong 'gyed pa'i 'phags chen brtson 'grus bzang dang shar chen rje// dpal mchog buddha'i mtshan mnga' bkra shis dpal dang de bzhin lhun gyis grub// rgyas sras dpal chos ngag dbang kun legs chos kyi 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi// ye shes kyis mtshon thog ma bar gyi bstan pa'i nyin byed byon rnams der// phyi nang rig pa'i gtsug lag yongs 'dzin zla bral de dag rigs kyi bdag

/spyi bos nyer bsten chos spyod rnam bcu'i legs mdzad tsakras bdag gir bgyid// brtse dang byang sems lang tsho dar bab rgyal ba'i myu gu 'gro 'dul ngor// rigs stobs mnga' 'byor bsgrun bral sa skyong dbang po gang byon bsngags pa'i 'os// deng 'dir dkon mchog gsum gyi phrin las gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar dbab phyir dang*// rgyal dang de sras dam pa'i lugs bzang bshad sgrub dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel phyir// skye dgu'i bsod nams zhing gyur bstan skyong gur gum nags ltar rgyas phyir dang*// klog spong chos tshul spyod pa bar med 'khor lo lta bur bskor phyir du// yul gyi dge mtshan phyogs kyi grangs mnyam rnam drug yul gyi dga' ston bzang*// bcu drug na tshod dar la bab mi dbyig 'dzin bu mo rang gi lus// yangs par sprul la chags bral yid kyang dbang med lhung lhung 'bab pa'i yul// dkar phyogs dgyes pa'i lha rnams rgyu skar lam srang lhags nas blta ba snyam// mi mchog sku la rdzogs pa'i dge mtshan re khās sgeg mdzes gang yin der// sriṃd gsuṃm bde dga' dpal 'byor dgeṃ leṃgs yoṃngs suṃ 'du ba'i chos grwa che'i// theg gsum bstan pa'i bgyi ba lhur len grangs med dge 'dun 'du ba'i gnas// gtsug lag khang chen rten dang brten pa'i ngo mtshar bkod pa'i sgyu 'phrul ngom// ji ltar bstan don brtsams las 'phros pa'i ngo mtshar 'bel gtam snyan pa'i dbyangs// dpyod ldan sgra 'dzin gtod la dga' mod 'dod ldan blun rmongs tshogs la min// yid 'phrog padma'i dri bsung 'thul la sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan 'phur lding rtsen// gcong rong khrod kyi mi gtsang mtshun zas la chags sha sbrang dag la de lta min// gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song de yi phrin las rgyas bya'i phyir// rten gsum bsod nams zhing gi phul bskrun rgyu sbyor bkod legs bzhugs pa'i grangs// phyag mchod bskor bas phu dud bgyis pa'i legs byas chu gter 'phel byed pa'i// dge ba gsum ldan mol mchid zla 'od gsar pa spro la 'dzum dmul zhig

/ci 'dod zang zing gnang bas bsgrubs 'di 'khor ba'i khe bun bskyed phyir min// gus dang spro ba'i brtun pa rmad byung khyim gyi so nam ngal dub min// tshul 'di'i sman yon lung rigs bsnyad pa gzhan 'drid stong pa'i kha gsag min// gang phyir rten dang brten mchod ngo mtshar gsar bskrun gleng bdag spro ba brtas// ces shis brjod phyag bya dngos po nges par bstan pas lam yangs par phye nas/ skabs su bab pa'i gleng ba/ rang re rnams rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi lus rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa dri ma med pa dang mjal/ chos rnams la chos mig rdul bral brnyes pa yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi sku drin la brten/ bstan pa'i 'jug sgo/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir// mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi// rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir// 'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid// ces 'byung ba ltar tshad med pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid dkon mchog gsum la theg pa dman mchog gi rim pa gang rung gi sgo nas skyabs su song zhing*/ de'i bslab par bgyi ba'i gnas rnams la rjes su slob cing rjes su sgrub pa dang*/ de dag gi rten gsum gyi gzugs brnyan mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bskrun pa dang*/ de dag bzhugs su gsol ba'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa dang*/ dgyes bskyed mchod pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pas mdun bdar nas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug dag gi legs nyes kyi blo gtod par som nyi'i drwa ba ma lus pa bcad pa las lhag pa'i bgyi ba ni ci yang bsgrub tu med pa'i phyir/ de bas na de dag gi don la rang gzhan sems can thams cad 'jug pa dang gzhug pa'i phyir khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa'i phrin las kyi zla snang dkar po sgo du ma nas 'byed pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa'i zhal snga nas kyi legs mdzad phrin las rin chen 'byung gnas chen po'i sgrun zlar bzod pa las/

ljongs kyi thig le 'dir srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du zhes bya ba'i chos grwa gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun pa'i tshul mchid pa la lnga ste/ gang du bskrun pa'i gnas der ji ltar bskrun pa/ rten dang brten pa'i bzhugs byang*/ rab tu gnas pas byin brlabs phan yon bcas/ mjug dge ba yongs su bsngo ba'o// dang po la'ang dgos pa dang dngos so// dang po ni/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ mdo don che ba nyid thos nas// nyan dang len pa la sogs la// nyan pa po de gus 'gyur bas// thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de'ang rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa zhes snyan grags dang phrin las nyi zla'i snang ba ltar phyogs su gsal ba/ gang de'i zhabs stegs bsnyengs bral mi 'jigs bzhi ldan chos kyi khri chen po la 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs zung rnam par bkod de/ rgyal ba'i phrin las kyi rgyun bzang po mkhas pa'i las gsum gyi sgo nas mi nub par bskyangs shing*/ ris bral gdul bya rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam dang 'bras bur sbyar ba'i sku drin bsgrun zla ma mchis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa'i gdan rabs pa/ mkhan po chen po shar chen chos kyi rgyal po nyid/ skye ba 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar gyi rigs kyi cod paṇa mchog tu thob par brten/ dpal stobs bcu mnga' ba bdag po bu ram shing skyes kyi rgyud du 'khrungs pa thams cad mkhyen pa thub mchog sras dang bcas pa'i bstan pa rin po che bla nas bla mar 'degs pa'i snying stobs mtshungs pa med pa rgyal ba'i sras chen stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mi bdag chen po'i tshul bzung ba sde dge blo gros rgya mtsho dral lcam nas/ rang gi chab 'bangs kyis mtshon pa'i 'gro ba rgya mtsho smin grol la dgod phyir thugs bskyed rmad byung gser gyi shing rtas/

bod chen ljongs kyi sa yi lto ba lhun grub steng gi gdan sa chen por spyan drangs te/ mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi don phyir/ yul gru kun du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur gyin phebs pa na/ grangs med skye bar shes bya'i gnas la sbyangs stobs mi dman pa'i ye shes gzigs pa'i me long dwangs par dgongs sgron du shar ba 'di lta ste/ kho bo cag bod chen ljongs 'dir 'ong ba'i dgos pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che la phan 'dogs mi dman tsam zhig gam/ yang na sems can gyi khams la phan pa'i lung rtogs chos kyi snang ba 'gyed pa zhig gam/ yang na mchod yon gong ma rnams kyis legs par bzhag pa'i dgon sde rnams nyams gso dang grwa tshogs kyi spyod lam bcas/ chos spyod kyi bsgrigs gsol/ grwa sa chen po'i mig ltos la 'gran pa zhig 'byung dgos su mchis mod/ deng skabs chos sde mi sde kun kyang nyams chags che skabs su song 'dug par gang phyogs nas shog thon 'ong bsam pa gtan ma shar/ lhag par yid lhung phyogs su mchod yon gong ma dag nas kyang dgon sde sogs 'debs pa'i thugs stsol gnang ma grub pas/ da lta'i grwa rigs rnams kyang 'brog gseb khyim pa rnams dang lhan cig nag gur nang du bsti gnas byed pa las 'os ma mchis pa la gzigs nas/ kye ma rab tu byung ba rnams grong gseb dang 'brog gseb tu mi nag pho mo rnams dang mnyam du 'gro 'chag bza' btung spyod lam gcig tu byed pa lta bu de 'dras sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi sger la phan pa lta zhog gnod tshabs chen por 'gyur ba dang*/ nang sgos su nged cag kyang rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i phrin las rjes su skyong ba pos khul yin mod/ bstan pa'i rjes 'jug rab tu byung ba rnams kyi 'dug tshul 'di 'dra mchis snyam pa'i do gnang chen po byung ba dang*/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge sa skyong chen po'i mnga' 'og la gzhan du grags tshod ltar na/

lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa chen po zhes bod pa'i don ni chos lugs te/ bstan pa'i bshad sgrub kyi dar srol dam pa'i chos dang mthun che ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi lugs te lugs kyi bstan bcos rgyal po ka niṣka la gdams par/ ci ste rgyal po blon po dag /dkyel che snying rje'i bdag nyid ni// rtag tu nyon mongs med pa yi// las kyis rgyal srid bya bar rung*// zhes dang*/ slob dpon ārya de was/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na// lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*// lha dang mi yi them skas la// brten na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces gsungs pa lta bu'i dge ba bcu'i khrims lugs dang mthun pa ste/ gnyis ka'i lugs srol dar srol che ba'i rgyal khab chen po zhig yin dgos pa la/ tshul 'di 'drar dpags na ci yang rung ba'i spyod lam 'di lta bus gnas chog pa ci zhig bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po'i dbu rna grags pa bcas la'ang 'di las gnod tshabs che ba ma mchis snyam nas/ nga rang gi snying thag pa nas yid lhung phyogs 'dir gtsug lag khang dang dgon sde zhig thebs na ci ma rung snyam pa yang yang shar/ der ma zad khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa nas kyang*/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen par bka' lung phebs nang du/ deng sang phyogs der sa ngor gyi chos sde rnams nyams chags song ba'i skabs yin yod tshod 'dug pas/ nyams gsos mkhan nyid las lhag pa su zhig 'byon lags pas/ nyid dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po mchod yon nas dgon sde nyams pa rnams gso zhing grwa tshag byed pa dang*/ dgon sde 'ga' zhig gsar du 'debs pa la sogs pas bstan pa'i bya ba la brtson pa gal che/ gal te dgon rnying 'gro don rdzogs zin pa nyams gso dka' ba byung tshe/ sa cha mthun rkyen 'dzom pa rnams su dgon sde 'ga' zhig gsar du bskrun pa mdzad na 'gro don phrin las rgyas pa 'byung srid pas thugs 'drongs gnang dgos zhes/

mkhan chen pa mchod yon la bkod pa stsal pa bcas rgyu mtshan du ma la bsams nas/ mdun chen la snyan sgron phul ba na thugs dgyes chen po dang lhan cig khu dbon nas kyang legs gsol gnang sbyin gya nom pa gnang ba bcas te dgon sde gtsug lag khang 'debs pa'i nyer bsdogs bsgrigs so// gnyis pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i gnas// legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang*// sa bzang pa dang yo byad dang*// rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan// zhes gsungs pa ltar sa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ khyad par yul gyi dge bcu tshang ba zhig dgos te/ de'ang ji skad du/ khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge /khang rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge /zhing chu 'thung chu chu yi dge /khang shing bud shing shing gi dge /gam 'brog rgyangs 'brog rtswa yi dge /zhes bshad pa'i dge mtshan gang du 'dzom pa'i sa btsal du bla ma rab dkar lhun grub can btang ba/ sngar gyi ge mdzo mdar chos rje khag sogs kyi bzhugs khang bskrun zin yang*/ der dge min gyi gleng ba mngon par shes rlom can 'ga' zhig gi dkar min gyi byed par brten/ cung zad 'thad pa ma shar bas/ slar zhib brtags bgyis pas lha rgyal srang zhes pa der dge mtshan phal cher tshang ba zhig mthong nas/ der 'gab min gyi dpyad pa mkhan chen nyid la zhus par/ rje btsun dam pa nyid nas kyang bla ma lha srung rnams la lung bstan zhu ba bcas thugs dpyad gnang bar/ sa cha der dge lam che ba'i dgongs bzhed shar nas der bskrun pa tshad de/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po'i dgongs bzhed dang mthun par zab cing rgya che ba'i mkhyen dpyod rnam par yangs pa phyag mdzod bla ma shes rab bzang po pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi zhal bkod zhib stsal gyis khyab par byas te/ las byed yongs kyi 'go dpon khur len par/ gtsug lag gzhung mang dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi me long dwangs pa bla ma rab dkar lhun grub pa dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar bcas dang*/

sa chog mkhan ni dus 'khor bla ma rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' phun tshogs pa dang*/ skar nag rtsis rgyud dang mthun pa'i bcos bsgrib skor gyi sa chog mkhan bla mkhyen tshe dbang don 'grub pa bcas brdzangs so// smras pa/ ma brdal tha gru yangs pa sa'i thig le// 'dris min 'gro ba'i yid kyang chags shing lhung*// ched du ma gnyer yul gyi dge bcu 'dzom// ma bskul lha rgyal rgyun lugs lam gyi srang*// zhes yid lhung lha rgyal srang gi chos sde srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba las/ gang du bskrun pa'i gnas kyi skabs te dang po'o// //gnyis pa der ji ltar bskrun pa la/ dus nam gyi tshe 'go brtsam pa/ sna tshogs las byed rnams kyis ji ltar bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba las/ gang la sa phyogs chos ldan zhing*// gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams// bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med par// gnas der rnal 'byor brtsam par bya// zhes 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sa der rab byung bcu gsum pa'i nang gsel stod 'grel gyi skad du thams cad 'dul zhes dang*/ ljongs 'dir dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming me mo phag tu bod pa/ dgu gling dbus kyi bdag po yul lha'i me long*/ 'byung ba bzhi ldan/ zla klung 'dzom pa'i gnam lo'i hor lugs kyi zla ba lnga pa rgya rtsis pa'i rta zla ba/ phugs lugs sprel zlar 'dod pa'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis par dar gud lang tsho/ lha'i bla ma 'tsho ba skyes dang rtse ba'i 'phrod chen glang po// 'byung ba me rlung 'dzom par/ gang du smos pa'i bla ma gtso bor bzhugs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge slong kha shas bcas pas sa gzhi mi mngon pa la sa slong sbyong gzung srung ba'i cho ga dang*/

bla mkhyen pas rtsis lugs dang mthun pa'i slong gzung sogs byas pa'i mthar/ rtsig rmang gi thig 'debs bcas grub nas/ rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la lhag pa mdza' lha phrad pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la ming bkra legs pa rnams kyis rmang 'ding ba sogs brtsam mo// gnyis pa la rten khang dpyad byed pa dang brten pa bris 'bur byed pa'o// dang por dus de nas bzung ste tshad de dang mthun par shing gshog pa rnams kyi shing bzo dang*/ gyang mkhan rnams kyis rdo brtsig gi rmang brtsig pa nas/ gyang brdung ba dang*/ gla len sa rdo bsags pa bcas nyin rer mi grangs brgya phrag gnyis lhag tsam gyi 'bad rtsol chen po'i sgo nas zla ba dgu pa'i 'go tshugs tsam gyi bar la las byed pa thams cad kyis rang las lta bu'i g.yo sgyu med pa mngon par bsgrubs pas gtsug lag khang steng shod phyir bcas grub pa byung*/ de'i phyi lor spen bad sogs sngar gyi las 'phro rnams bsdod mkhan dang*/ gtsug lag khang phyi nang gi zhal ba mkhan bcas pas legs bris kyi sta gon tshun chad grub par byas so// gnyis pa ni/ karma lha ltem gyi bzo rigs mkhas pa'i rtse mo lha dpon lha dga' can spun sogs dang dpal yul chab mdo zla rgyud sogs nas lha ris pa brgyad cu tsam dang*/ 'di nas drung yig rnam par dpyod ldan shākya chos 'phel lha ris pa spyi'i kha ta bar btang nas/ shing tshon dang logs ris phyi nang gi 'go tshugs te/ de'ang bris 'bur gyi sku gang yang rang dgar byas pa tsam gyis mi chog par tshad dang mtshan nyid ldan par bskrun dgos te/ ji skad du/ ma pham byams pas/ sku ni n+ya gro dha ltar chu zhing gab// ces gsungs pa'i don de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bris 'bur gnyis kar khyad par med pa sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa'i tshad du chu zheng gab par dgos te/ de'ang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rgyal ba'i bdag po gtsug tor nas ni mdzod spu'i dbus su phyed dang bcas pa'i nyi ma'i sor du 'gyur/

de nas mgrin pa'i chu skyes de bzhin snying ga dang ni de nas lte gsang chu skyes de bzhin no// zhabs kyi mthil dang rje ngar brla dang dpyi yang ma nu de nyid de nyid rig byed rnams kyis te// brang phyed phyed bcas nyi ma'i rang dpung dpung lag rnams ni kha mig rgyal po nyi ma'i tshad kyis so// nyi shu rtsa lngas lhag pa'i brgya phrag ces sku'i phyed tshad re la sor mo phyed bcas re gnyis re bsdoms pa sor mo brgya nyer lnga 'byung bar bshad pa dang*/ rgyud sdom pa 'byung bar/ mthil lam thal mo bcu gnyis kyi// lha yi gzugs ni bri bar bya// zhes dang*/ zab mo rdo rje can gyi lha// cha ni bcu gnyis mtshan nyid do// zhes pa'ang phyed bcas bcu gnyis su byas pa'i tshe dang*/ sman lha don 'grub pa dang sprul sku 'phrang kha ba sogs kyi cha tshad las kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa kho nar bshad do// thig chen gnyis po de las gzhan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sku rnams la/ sdom 'byung 'grel par/ mtshams dang mtshams la so sor cha chung gnyis gnyis chad par 'gyur te/ des na byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa zhi ba'i lha rnams sku'i stod dang sku smad dag gi cha chung phyed dang bcas pa gnyis gnyis phri ba las cha chung nyi shus lhag pa brgya'i tshad kyi skur 'gyur ro zhes dgongs pa'o// zhes dang*/ yang sangs rgyas kyi tshad bstan pa'i rjes thogs su 'di dag ni re zhig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang dpal bde mchog gi mtshan nyid de/ byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnams kyi'ang 'di dag kho na'o// 'on kyang thal mo bcu rnams la'ang thal mo so sor cha chung phyed phyed dor nas cha chung bcu gnyis pa'i thal mos thal mo bcu'i rnam bzhag bya'o zhes dang*/ bslab btus las kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yang sor bcu gnyis pa'i mtho bcu pa nyid do// zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don ni/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i tshad ji lta ba bzhin las/ khyad par ni cha chung bcu gnyis pa'i zhal tshad kyis gzhal bas cha phran brgya nyi shu pa 'byung bar bstan mod/ phyis kyi mkhas pa kha cig de dag la rtogs dpyod ma zhugs pa 'phrang kha ba'i cha tshad kyi mchan bur dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa ni 'bur sku dang*/ sdom 'byung nas bshad pa'i brgya nyi shu pa ni bris sku'i dbang du byas pa'o// zhes sogs 'byung bar brten/ deng sang gi lha bzo phal cher cha tshad la nan tan byed pa nyung zhing*/ thig 'debs khul byed pa rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i tshad de kho nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang yum bzhi sogs lha mo rnams kyi tshad la'ang 'debs pa'i bab col byed pa rnams ni e raṇḍa ltar snying po yod pa ma mthong ngo*// thig chen gsum pa rgyal yum yid 'phrog pa'i gzugs can rnams ni/ sdom 'byung las/ yid du 'ong ba'i rang gzugs ni// thal mo dgu pa mngon par 'dri// zhes 'phags ma sgrol ma la sogs pa rigs kyi lha mo rnams sku'i srid zheng la thal mo dgu pa ste/ de'ang 'jal byed zhal tshad ni byang chub sems dpa'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par thod dpangs mgrin pa pus mo bol rnams nas cha phran re res dman pas brgyad kyis lhag pa'i sor mo brgya 'byung bas srid tshad dang*/ mchan khung dang dpung lhu dang phyag ngar nas sor mo do re dbri bas zhing gi tshad kyang rtogs te zhib par gzhung don lag khrid byed pa las shes par bya'o// thig chen bzhi pa sbom thung gtum drag can rnams ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ khro bo khro mo dbang phyug ma// bran po bran mo ci bgyi ma// drag cing 'jigs pa'i gzugs rnams ni// thal mo brgyad pa rnam par 'dri// zhes 'byung zhing 'grel par gdan gyi mtha' nas skra'i zhags pa'i bar du shes par bya'o// zhes thung zhing sbom pa gsus pa 'phyang ba khro bo gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa ni thal mo brgyad du bshad pa ltar te 'di dag lag len du 'debs pa'i tshul bshad par bya ba mang du mchis mod/

yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas gong 'og kun du ma spros so// thig chen lnga pa mi'u thung ltar khros pa rnams ni/ kri ya sa mutstshar/ rā hū la dang mi'u thung dang tshogs kyi bdag po rnams ni mtho lnga par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don lag tu blang ba'i rim par srid zheng mnyam par sor mo don gnyis par bshad pa ltar te/ ji skad du/ brkyang bskum skyed 'phri mkhas pas nyams dang sbyar// zhes 'byung ba ltar 'gying stabs la sogs pa'i dbri bskyed dgos pa mkhas pa'i nyams dang sbyar tshul shes par bya'o// thig chen drug pa nyan rang sogs mi'i tshad la/ dri med 'od las/ de nyid sems can rnams kyi khru bzhi ste// mi rnams kyi ni sor mo dgu bcu rtsa drug go /steng dang 'og tu ni sor brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ste de ltar mi rnams ni mtshan dang mi ldan pa'o zhes pa ste/ de'ang nyan thos rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshad ltar bshad pa'ang yod cing*/ lag len la'ang de ltar byas pa mthong zhing*/ rang rgyal ni mi'i tshad du byed pa'ang bshad pa yod do// de lta bu'i tshad dang mi ldan pa'i rten la rab gnas 'chags par ma gsungs pas bris 'bur gyi sku gang la'ang so so'i skabs nas bshad pa'i rang rang gi tshad dang mthun pa nyid bya ba shin tu gal che mod/ de dag gi lag khrid phal cher kho bo cag gi slob bur gyur pa drung yig shākya chos 'phel dang lha dpon lha dga' gnyis la goms 'dris cung zad song ba yod pa de gnyis 'go dpon dang kha ta bar bskos/ gtsang khang gi thub chen gsum gyis gtsos pa'i lder bzo ba thams cad dbus lha zhi ba rdo rje can btang nas bzheng du bcug par/ thog ma'i rmang 'ding ba nas rten bzheng gi bya ba mthar phyin pa'i bar la gegs dang bar chad ci yang ma byung bar/ mkhan chen dam pa'i thugs bzhed kyi bkod pa ji ltar gnang don ltar grub pa ni/ skyabs mchog thugs rje'i bdag nyid chen po nyid nas dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje bskul ba dang*/

bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi bsgos pa'i phrin las bran bzhin du bsgrubs par gdon mi za ba nyid do// smras pa/ sa gzhi bslangs sbyangs bzung dang bsrungs pa der// sna tshogs las pas legs brtsigs gtsug lag khang*// de nang mkhas pa'i gzhung gi thig khong las// phyung ba'i lha tshogs sku brnyan phreng ba bstar// zhes yid lhung lha rgyal srang gi chos sde srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba las/ der ji ltar bskrun pa'i tshul bsnyad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //gsum pa rten dang brten pa'i bzhugs byang la/ bris 'bur gnyis las/ thog mar gtsug lag khang gi dngos gzhi ka ba sum cu yod pa'i/ gtsang khang gi sgo yi g.yas logs kyi gtso bo ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po nyan thos mchog brgyad dang bcas pa/ sgo 'gram g.yon ngos kyi gtso bo rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la so thar sdom brgyud kyi bla mas bskor ba/ de las gzhan pa'i gtsug lag khang gi sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon gyi zhing khams gnyis min pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi gyang logs thams cad du 'phags pa'i yul gyi snyan dngags mkhan chen po chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po yab sras la rmi lam du/ de bzhin gshegs pas bskul nas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi yal 'dab brgya dang brgyad kyis bstan pa gzugs bkod ri mo'i lam du legs par drangs pas khyab par byas/ sgo 'gram g.yas su bstan srung rdo rje gur mgon 'khor bcas dang*/ dpal mgon bram gzugs yum chen bzhi bcas dang*/ dur khrod/ dmag zor/ las kyi gshin rje/ dkar bdud phur srung gnyis ru 'dren sde bzhi dang bcas pas bskor ba/ g.yon logs su gter bdag rnam mang thos sras la gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad dang*/

rmugs 'dzin ser nag dkar dmar/ nor rgyun ma bcas dang*/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po dpon slob/ sa skyong bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dral lcam lha sras sku 'khor bcas pa'i gzugs bkod bcas dang*/ gtsug lag sgo gong du dmar po skor gsum dang dmar mo skor gsum/ gzhan thams cad kyi steng gi nam mkha' la 'phags bod kyi bla ma phal cher dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas kyi rigs mang du bzhugs pa dang*/ rgya mthongs kyi phugs logs gtso bo rdo rje 'chang*/ sa skya pa chen po/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ g.yas logs su rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ g.yon logs su sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa ste/ lnga po de dag la lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ g.yas mthar dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub la rgyan drug mchog gnyis jo bo yab sras/ btsong kha pa dang*/ rgyal dbang lnga pa bcas/ g.yon mthar slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la/ bod la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba'o// gtsang khang nang gi mdun ngos kyi logs bris/ g.yas kyi gtso bo sgrol dkar tshe sbyin ma 'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i sgrol mas bskor ba/ g.yon logs gtso bo rnam rgyal ma la lha brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ sgo gong gtso bo tshe dpag tu med pa ste gsum ga'i 'khor du tshe dpag med dang*/ tshe sbyin sgrol ma sogs tshe'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba'o// gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol sgo logs g.yas g.yon du mi g.yo ba dang*/ bgegs mthar byed gnyis/ 'gram g.yas g.yon du sgo srung rgyal chen bzhi/ sgo'i mdun logs g.yas g.yon du 'dul ba nas bshad pa'i srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa/ bstan ma bcu gnyis/ rdo rje g.yung drung sogs gzhi bdag 'ga' re rnams so// mgon khang nang logs ngos gzhi nag po'i steng du/ yi dam dang mgon po'i bla ma brgyud pa thor bu dang*/ las byed shan pa'i gzugs bkod spyan gzigs 'ga' re rnams dang bcas pa ni logs bris so// gnyis pa 'bur sku la/

gtsang khang gi gtso chen thub dbang bdud 'dul can sku tshad/ gdan khri la mtho tshad bdun/ sku dngos mtho tshad bcu gsum yod par rgyab yol rgyan drug dang*/ nyan thos mchog zung gnyis bcas/ de'i g.yas su sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang*/ g.yon du sangs rgyas byams pa gnyis sku dngos la mtho tshad bcu re yod pa/ lha chen de gsum gyi mdun phyogs g.yas g.yon du bla ma bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan/ tshe dpag tu med pa/ shar chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa sku tshad che tsam yod pa/ gyang ngos bar mtshams rnams su brag ri'i khrod du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam gzigs/ gtsug tor can/ thams cad skyob/ 'khor ba 'jig gser thub/ sman bla/ 'od dpag med rnams mtho tshad re/ g.yas g.yon gyi logs gnyis su brag ri bkod legs kyi khrod du bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug dharma tā/ ha shang*/ rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan rnams bzhugs/ gtsug lag khang gi phugs su rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku rnams bzhugs so// de rnams la nang rten khyad par can bzhugs tshul rag pa tsam brjod na/ gtso bo thub chen gyi dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung rin po che'i za ma tog tu bzhugs pa/ chos sku'i ring bsrel la dbu nas mgrin pa'i bar lhun grub steng 'di nyid kyi gzungs par las 'byung ba ltar/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs rnams ka nas cha'i bar sde tshan sum cu tham pa tshar gsum re/ mgrin pa nas thugs ka'i bar du rgyud sde gong ma'i gzungs sde tshan lngar byas pa cha bcu/ thugs ka'i smad nas lte ba yan chad du rgyud sde 'og ma'i gzungs sde tshan lngar byas pa tshar brgyad/ de dag gi stod smad kun du gzungs chen sde lngar grags pa gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyas 'bum/ rten 'brel snying po rnams tshar bcu/

mdo gzungs skor sde tshan sngar byas pa tshar bdun/ skyil krung man chad du chos skyong dang nor lha'i skor sde tshan bcu po bzhi re dang*/ bkra shis smon lam skor sde tshan bcu po tshar lnga re/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol tshar bdun dang*/ dbus su srog shing la 'dri 'jug gi gzungs rnams rgyas par bris nas srog shing dang gzungs de dag thams cad dar gos ser po'i na bza' dang bcas te bzhugs/ rgya bod kyi paṇḍi ta lo tsā ba mkhas btsun grub pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi spur thal/ spur ras/ sku bal/ tshems dang phyag sen/ sku mtshal/ dbu zhwa/ na bza' la sogs pa'i sku chas rnams dpal sa skya/ e waṃ chos ldan sogs kyi rten 'dam dpe bral ma'i dkar chag rgyas pa 'og tu bshad pa ltar gsar byung cung zad min pa der gsal ba ltar dang*/ gzhan yang gtsang paṇa chen/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa/ sde dge sa skyong rim byon rnams kyi phyag nas brgyud de 'ongs pa'i rten 'dam byin rlabs dpe zla dang bral pa'i rigs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i 'jim pa las grub pa'i sku brnyan/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bstan srung nor lha rnams kyi sku par brgyab pa dang*/ sātstsha bcas khyon bsdoms pa bzhi bcu zhe gsum tsam la gser dngul gyi rtsi tshon gsol ba na bza' dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ byin rten ril bu'i rigs la sa skya'i gong ma lnga sogs skyes chen rim byon rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i dam rdzas ril bu'i rigs dang tshe sgrub kyi ril bu'i rigs sogs bzhugs grangs zhib pa gsham gsal ltar 'dir re re nas 'dri ba yi ges ngal gyis dogs pas ma bris so// de dag ni sku'i dbu nas mgrin pa dang thugs ka'i stod yan chad bzhugs su gsol/ gzhan yang skye bdun gyi sha dang*/ sngags 'chang bsod nams rin chen pa'i dbu zhwa sgang po rnams kyang der bzhugs/ thugs kar khyad par gyi 'dod gsol gser gyis bris pa/

dzhai chim las grub pa'i thub dbang sku byin ldan/ li ser las grub pa'i shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas sku rgya nag ma/ gser zangs las grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang bzo legs/ ljon dmar las grub pa'i 'od dpag med kyi sku/ gser zangs las grub pa'i sgrol ma bzo legs/ 'khar ba'i thub sku/ tsandan dmar po las grub pa'i slob dpon pad 'byung*/ bka' gdams mchod rten rgya nag ma byin ldan/ li dmar las grub pa'i gur mgon rnams bzhugs/ sku rked nas skyil krung gi stod cha yan chad la/ sher phyin brgyad stong pa bi warta can dang*/ mdo rgyud kyi bka' nye bar mkho ba bsdus pa'i glegs bam/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar glegs bam gsum dar gos kyi na bza' dang bcas te bzhugs so// gdan khri'i nang du mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub pa dag gis rtags thon du bsgrubs pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang*/ yang gnod sbyin 'khor lo gser gyis bris pa dang par brgyab pa rnams dang*/ mgon dkar gyi gter bum gsum/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin gyi bang mdzod dar gos dang*/ rin po che'i rigs dkar mngar shing thog gi rigs 'bras sogs 'bru sna tshogs rnams so sor ras kyi khug mar blugs pa mang po dang*/ 'phags yul gyi sa sna/ bal yul mchod rten/ gangs ti se/ tsa ri tra/ bod kyi gnas chen rnams dang*/ rgya nag glang chen 'gying ri sogs kyi sa sna dang*/ bzang sman rigs kyi khrob dang phye ma rnams kyis khengs par bkang ngo*// g.yas kyi gtso chen mar me mdzad dang g.yon gyi byams chen rgyal ba'i sku gnyis kyi dbu'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung dang*/ stod smad kun du chos sku'i ring bsrel dang*/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo yan chad kyi gzungs rnams dang*/ byin rten khyad 'phags rnams las btab pa'i sku brnyan gyi rigs dang*/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu sogs ril bu'i rigs bzhugs tshul phal cher thub dbang gi sku'i nang bzhugs pa ltar dang*/

dmigs bsal mar me mdzad kyi sku'i dbu nang du li ser las grub pa'i 'phags pa rin po che'i sku rgya bzo khyad 'phags/ thugs kar gser zangs las grub pa'i thub dbang sku prog zhu can dang sgrol ljang*/ bka' gdams gdung rten rgya bzo legs pa/ mdo sde bskal ba bzang po/ mdo rgyud kyi bka' nye bar mkho ba bsdus pa'i glegs bam rnams bzhugs so// byams chen rgyal ba'i sku'i nang du rgya li las grub pa'i thub dbang sku/ gser zangs las grub pa'i thub dbang dang sgrol ljang*/ bka' gdams gdung rten rgya bzo legs pa/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong ba'i dbu zhwa sgang po/ mdo rgyud kyi bka' nye bar mkho ba bsdus pa'i glegs bam/ gzhan gnod sbyin bang mdzod kyi rin po che 'bru rigs sogs sngar thub chen gyi skabs ltar rgyas par bzhugs so// sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang*/ sman bla/ 'od dpag med/ ston pa'i nyan thos mchog gnyis/ 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug ha shang*/ dharma tā/ rgyal chen bzhi rnams kyi nang gzungs la/ chos sku'i ring bsrel/ gzungs par rgyas pa gnod sbyin 'khor lo bcas cha re/ gang du smos pa'i rten 'dam las grub pa'i bla ma yi dam sogs kyi sku lnga re/ dam rdzas ril bu'i rigs dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi sku bal na bza' sogs byin rten rnams rgyas pa bzhugs so// bla ma bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan dang tshe dpag tu med pa/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa gsum gyi sku brnyan dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku brnyan rnams kyi nang rten du chos sku'i ring bsrel rgyas pa cha mang po bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol gser gyis bris pa dang*/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa dang*/ gong ma rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros pas bsgrubs pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang*/

sku de dag gi thugs kar dzhai chim las grub pa'i thub dbang gi sku/ tshe dpag med kyi gser sku/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa li ma/ sa skya gong ma rin po che nas gnang ba'i thub dbang gser sku rab gnas can la/ gong ma nyid nas 'dod gsol dmigs bsal gnang bas dkris pa phyag rgyas btab pa dang*/ sku'i lto bar dmar po skor gsum gyi sku brnyan sa skya gong ma nyid kyis phyag bstar mdzad pa dang*/ de nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i dmar po skor gsum gyi 'khor lo byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i yid bzhin nor bu lta bu rnams bzhugs so// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa'i sku brnyan gyi nang du chos sku'i ring bsrel dang byin rlabs rten gyi rigs gong gsal ltar dang*/ khyad par du thub dbang sku dang*/ sgrol ma dkar mo li las grub pa/ gser zangs las grub pa'i kun dga' bzang po'i sku/ ljon dmar las grub pa'i dzambha la ser po sgros legs/ bskal bzang rgyan phreng*/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ sdud pa sogs yod pa'i pod chung rnams bzhugs so// mgon khang rten gyi gtso bo rdo rje gur mgon mtho bdun gyi tshad/ g.yas g.yon du dpal mgon bram gzugs/ e ka dzā ṭī/ lha mo 'dod khams dbang mo/ dmag zor ma/ las mgon lnga/ dur khrod yab yum/ gnod sbyin beg tse'i sku brnyan rnams khru tshad re la nang rten chos sku'i ring bsrel tshar mang po dang*/ khyad par chos srung nor lha'i gzungs tshar shin tu mang po dang*/ byin rten khyad 'phags kyi rigs bzhugs pa rnams 'og tu 'byung ba ltar dang*/ khyad par mgon chen sku'i dbu nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung*/ thugs kar tsandan dkar po las grub pa'i mgon sku mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi thugs dam rten khyad 'phags/ kha'u rdo nag la bram gzugs kyi sku bris pa/ gnam lcags rdo rje gter ma 'khrul med/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang*/

mgon chen gyi sku rgyab gyang gseb tu mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i gter bum/ dzambha la dkar po 'brug zhon gyi gter bum/ grwa pa mngon shes nas brgyud pa'i dzambha la dmar po'i gter bum rnams rtags thon du bsgrubs pa rnams bzhugs so// gong du smos so cog gi sku rten che chung thams cad du khyab par bzhugs pa la/ dpal sa skya ngor sde dge rim byon gyi thugs dam rten du bzhugs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i rten 'dam dpe bral mar grags pa'i nang du byin rten ji ltar 'dus pa'i tshul so sor bshad na/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi tshems/ slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas dang ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi phyag bris kyi gter shog tshal bu/ slob dpon chen po nyid kyi shangs mtshal/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i phyag tshwa'i dum bu/ paṇa chen ga ya dha ras bsgrubs pa'i bum chu'i rgyun/ sa chen kun dga' snying po'i gdung rus/ bsod nams rtse mo'i sku chings/ rje btsun grags pa'i sku ber/ sa skya paṇa chen gyi dbu skra/ 'phags pa rin po che'i chibs ngang pa gser ldan gnyis kyi tshems/ 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge'i dbu lo// bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i na bza'/ paṇa chen nags rin gyi sku chos/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan pa'i spur ras/ red mda' ba 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi sku chings/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi spur thal na bza'/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i na bza'/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i dbu lo/ na bza'/ sku chings/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi na bza'/ rje rdo ring pa'i zhun thig theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i spur sha glo bo mkhan chen pa'i gdung rus/ spur ras/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i dbu zhwa/ mgul sgrog sku chings/ sangs rgyas seng ge'i spur rus/ rje tshar chen gyi dbu lo/ na bza'/ spur rus/

thugs dam gtor ma/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi spur rus ril bu dang*/ skye bdun a ma/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i spur rus/ dbang phyug rab brtan pa'i dbu lo/ na bza'/ sku chings/ sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi spur rus/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i phyag phreng*/ spur rus/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams pa'i dbu lo/ shangs mtshal/ phyag zhabs kyi sen mo/ sngags 'chang chen po'i na bza'/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i tshems la ring bsrel byon pa/ dbu lo/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug pa'i dbu lo/ na bza'/ sgar chen mthu stobs dbang phyug pa'i na bza'/ rje 'gyur med bde chen gyi dbu lo/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags dbu lo/ na bza'/ spyan lnga kun dga' don 'grub dbu lo/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan gyi spur rus/ thar rtse paṇa chen gyi dbu lo/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub dang*/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis kyi gdung rus/ rje sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ shar chen sher 'byung*/ dpal mchog rgyal mtshan gsum gyi spur rus/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan spur rus/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis pa'i dbu lo/ spur rus/ spur sol/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi spur rus/ sngags 'chang kun dga' dbang rgyal dbu lo/ brtan pa rab rgyas pa'i tshems la ring bsrel byon pa/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan dang*/ tā ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis kyi spur rus/ thub bstan mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bkra shis dpal ldan/ ngor dbu mdzad kun dga' dpal 'byor/ rje shes bya bzang po/ tshul khrims dpal bzang pa rnams kyi spur rus/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen pa'i dbu lo/ na bza'/ spur rus phye ma tsandan gyi 'dam dang bsres pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas rten 'dam du byas pa'i khar/

slar yang dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas rten bzheng gi thugs rtsol rmad byung rtsom pa'i skabs bshad ma thag pa'i dkar chag tu ma 'khod pa'i kha 'phang gsar du bsnan pa mang po bcas pa'i rten 'dam gong ma rin po che de nyid kyi phyag nas stsal ba dang*/ gzhan yang ljongs 'di'i mkhas dbang bla ma bkra shis dbang phyug pas/ sa skyong bla ma sangs rgyas bstan pa dang*/ bsod nams phun tshogs/ tshe dbang rdo rje/ bstan pa tshe ring rnams kyi thugs dam rten du bzhugs pa rten bzhengs chen po'i skabs su phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i rten 'dam rnams sngar smos pa de dag tu ma 'dres pa med cing*/ der ma thus pa'i byin rten khyad 'phags mang po yod sgros 'dug kyang dkar chag tu ma bkod pas yi ge 'dri ba ma nus so// der ma zad bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i dam rdzas ril bu khyad par can rnams kyi rgyun yang 'dres pa'i tshul ni/ dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ na bza' brag phug pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo tsā ba kun dga' bsod nams/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*/ sngags 'chang chen po/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ grags pa blo gros/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngor khang gsar bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ byams pa tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ byams pa bsod nams bzang po/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i dam rdzas myong grol ril bu byin rlabs can rnams dang*/ sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i zhal sgo nas dam rdzas rlon pa byon pa sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen pas phyag gi bzhes pa'i dum bu ngo mtshar can dang*/

gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje'i bdud rtsi chos sman/ skye bdun ril bu/ ma ṇi ril bu/ rdor sems thugs sgrub ril bu/ 'dus pa mdo'i gsang rdzas/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis pas bsgrubs pa'i bde gshegs kun 'dus ril bu'i dub bu gsar bsnan bcas dang*/ gzhan yang dam rdzas ril bu'i 'jim par la dad sgrol chen po nyid nas phyag bstar btab pa'i sku brnyan gyi rigs rnams dang lhan cig dpal sa skya pa de nyid nas bka' drin du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan yang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po'i phyag nas byung ba'i ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste/ mkhan po sangs rgyas ye shes yan chad kyi e waṃ pa'i gdan rabs rim byon gyi sku bal/ na bza'/ spur thal sogs rten 'dam byas nas par brgyab pa'i sku brnyan dang sātstsha'i rigs/ mkhan rabs rim pas bsgrubs pa'i dam rdzas ril bu dang*/ dam rdzas kyi 'jim par gyi sku lnga/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong pa'i na bza' dang*/ dbu lo gdung khrus shangs mtshal rnams rten 'dam byas nas par brgyab pa'i sku brnyan gyi rigs rnams dang*/ klu sdings zhabs drung phyag nas byung ba'i gong ma rim byon gyi dbu lo/ na bza'/ gdung tshwa/ dam rdzas ril bu sogs phon che ba/ thar rtse zhabs drung nas thar pa rtser mngar ba'i byin rlabs rten gyi rigs dang*/ gdung tshwa/ na bza'/ dam rdzas ril bu bcas phon che ba rnams kyang bzhugs pa ste/ skal bzang dad pa dang ldan pa rnams yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir dkar chag tu smos pa ste srid na shin tu dkon zhing byin rlabs kyi gzi brgya 'bar ba'i rang bzhin du slar bcas skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing dam par bzhugs su gsol nas/ phyag dang bskor ba mchod 'bul bgyis pa'i tshe rabs du ma'i sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i cho ga mkhan du thob pa dpe zla dang bral ba nyid do// smras pa/ brtan pa sku brnyan gtso bo shākya thub// 'das dang ma byon rgyal ba mgron lha'i rigs// bka' srung 'khor bcas rnams dang ldeb ris su// rtogs brjod che sogs rab 'byams zhing khams sprul// zhes yid lhung lha rgyal srang gi chos sde srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba las/

rten dang brten pa'i bzhugs byang bsnyad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o// //bzhi pa rab tu gnas pas byin brlabs phan yon dang bcas pa la gsum ste/ las byed mnyes par byas pa/ rab gnas ji ltar byas pa/ phyag mchod bskor ba byas pa'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ las mthar phyin nas bzo bo mnyes dgos pa ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ bzo bo ma mnyes pa'i lha la ni ye shes pa mi 'jug ste/ rab gnas kyi thog mar bzo bo mnyes par bya'o// zhes dang*/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod par/ de bas na bzo 'ba' zhig mi rnams kyi nyams su sman pa yin te/ bzo bo ni rigs dma' bar skyes na'ang rgyal po rnams dang*/ bram ze dang*/ khyim bdag rnams kyis gdon mi za bar bkur ro// sna tshogs las pa lha rnams dang*// mi rnams kyis kyang legs par bkur// de bzhin ma rabs bzo ba'i phyir// mi dang lha rnams kyis kyang bkur// zhes bshad pas bzo bo ni thams cad kyis mchod cing bkur ba dang*/ mgu bar bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa nyid de/ des na gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa 'di dag bskrun pa'i las byed rnams la gla yon sogs ji ltar so sor byin pa yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas mi 'dri na'ang*/ 'dir rags bsdus tsam smos na/ zung gi mdo las/ gang dag nga yi bstan pa la// sbyin pa skra tsam byin pa ni// bskal pa stong phrag brgyad cu ru// longs spyod che zhing nor yang mang*// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rten gsum 'di dag bskrun pa'i las byed rdo bzo ba/ mgar ba/ gyang brdung ba/ shing bzo ba/ sa rdo shing gsum gsog pa'i gla len pa/ zha la ba/ spen bad pa sogs dang*/ logs ris 'dri ba'i lha dpon lha dga' sogs lha bzo ba dpon g.yog dang las byed shin tu mang ba rnams dang bcas pa la/ rgyun par gyis bza' btung dang*/ thog mtha' bar gsum gyi ston mo/ dpa' dar/ spyan 'byed/

tshar ston/ yon 'bul/ gla rngan bcas par so sor ster rgyu'i rim pa la/ bskol ja gzhung ma dang*/ bzang ja'i rigs/ thug pa/ 'debs mar/ 'debs tshwa/ bud shing*/ gsal sgron/ rtsam nas/ gro/ ston chas su 'bras/ gro ma/ shing thog rigs/ mngar gsum/ thud dkar ser/ sha dkar nag bzo spyad la dgos pa'i lcags zangs rag phon che ba/ bris 'bul lha'i rtsi tshon spyin gser shog gser 'dur spra rtsi sogs mkho dgos yo byad dngos dang*/ sgrub pa'i rten dang*/ yon 'bul/ rnam gzhag gla rngan bcas pa'i ched du dgos byar/ ma hā tsi na'i yul grur 'phrul bzos btags pa'i dar gyi rigs/ sman tse/ srin thag ras tshos kha dog sna tshogs dang*/ la da/ ling*/ shug tshang*/ a la cag se ra le pa/ gos chen gsar rnying tshos kha sna tshogs yug shin tu mang ba dang*/ gcan gzan lpags rigs la/ wa/ sbre/ spyang*/ gung*/ g.yi/ gsa'/ sram/ gzig stag rnams kyi pags pa grangs mang ba dang*/ snam bu/ phrug ther ma/ mgo snam rnams bubs mang po dang*/ sbu har sogs ko bubs kyi rigs/ ras phrug gos chen/ spa phrug o rod su rnams kyi gos sna mang po dang*/ sag lh+wam sogs lh+wam gyi rigs/ phreng ba rgyan ldan bzang 'bring sna tshogs/ byi ru/ spos shel/ gzi/ mchong*/ g.yu/ dngul phob/ dngul gyi rna kor sogs pho mo'i lus chas mang po/ gla gor sha dang rdzab kyi phor pa/ rdor dril ting shag sogs mchod cha'i rigs/ rta sga gzar stan dngul gyi srab smed sogs 'khor tshang cha grangs dang*/ gser/ dngul/ du ba ko ṭa/ gzhung ja/ shan ja/ chung ju/ ko tse'i rigs rnams 'khor drug mang po dang*/ 'bri/ g.yag mdzo/ mdzo mo/ rta drel rnams so so'i sde tshan mang po rnams ni rten bzheng dang*/ las byed rnams la dgos pa'i cha rkyen dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang mgon khang rnams su gtan 'jog mchod pa'i yo byad kyi rigs la/ mchod 'bul gyi snod ting phor che 'bring chung gsum/ mar me'i kong bu che chung rnams dang*/

phud kong*/ maṇḍal/ lhung bzed/ ka pā la/ sil snyan dung dkar sogs rol cha'i rigs/ bla bre/ rgyal mtshan/ 'phan/ yol ba/ snyan shal gyi dar sna/ g.yab dar/ 'phyar dar sogs mchod rdzas kyi rigs gya nom pa dang*/ gzims chung mdo phugs/ gnyer khang*/ gsol thab/ mang thab sogs la mkho ba'i yo byad tshang bar bcas rnams phyogs gcig bsdebs pa dngos ja'i gang tshod du phab nas rtsis pa khyon bsdoms gzhung ja 'khor drug nyis stong bdun brgya so gsum dang ja sbag gcig lhag bcas kyi bab 'gro nges kyis mngon par bsgrubs pa'i srid zhi'i mchod sdong bla na med pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun pa'i tshul rnams/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po par snyan gsan du phul ba na/ thugs dgyes bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur pa dang mnyam du/ gong du smos pa'i byin rten khyad 'phags rnams dang*/ srid zhi'i yid smon zhes bya ba'i chos dung byin rlabs can 'bud dung rgyur gnang ba dang*/ dgon sde gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa la/ srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du zhes mtshan du stsal ba dang*/ mdzod dar mdzod gos yug ring sogs kyi gnang sbyin gya nom pa dang bcas pa'i legs gsol stsal to// de lta bu'i bstan phan gyi bya ba chen po 'di nyid mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdo khams ljongs kyi skye 'gro spyi'i bsod nams spel ba'i phyir dang*/ bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du dgongs nas thugs bskyed dang byang chub kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bur bskyed pa na/ sa skyong bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos mtshon pa'i gnyer las 'dzin bla ma dge slong spyi las tshan sbyin bdag pho mo sogs nas/ mkhan chen dam pa'i byang chub spyod pa'i rjes su sgrub cing rjes su slob par 'dod pa'i skal ldan rnams kyis 'brel 'jog bgyis pas/

tshe rabs kun du mi 'bral bar lhan cig 'grogs pa ni smon lam gyi mthu ste/ bzang po spyod pa las/ bdag gi spyod dang mtshungs par gang spyod pa// de dag dang yang rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang*// spyod pa dag dang smon lam gcig tu spyad// ces sogs 'byung ba'i phyir ro// tshul de dag la dgongs pa'i sa skyong chos kyi rgyal po blo gros rgya mtsho pa dral lcam nas/ bkra shis pa'i lha dar srid du ring ba gnyis/ sman yug gnyis/ ling yug bzhi/ zam su sna tshogs yug bcu/ la da yug gnyis/ dar khra yug gos 'jam yug gser ma yug cod ldan yug dngul srang lnga bcu'i rta mig ma/ wa skyes/ gung*/ gsa'/ sbre/ chu sram/ g.yi dkar/ spyang ki gzig stag rnams kyi pags pa re/ drel rta chibs dang chibs rol/ ras dkar yug bcas rnam grangs so bdun/ lha sras chos skyong mgon pos/ lcags chen dang zangs chen/ lcags chas sna tshogs/ nas khal sum brgya/ gro khal nyis brgya/ lha lcam dngos grub dpal 'dzom nas lha rdzas/ ras yug gnyis/ ling yug gos yug wa/ g.yi/ gzig gsum gyi pags pa re/ rta pho bcas dgu tshan/ gnyer chen don grub/ nor bu dgra 'dul/ bu rgyal/ mgon po chos bzang*/ mgon po tshe ring lngas/ lha rdzas/ ras yug gnyis/ gos yug wa lpags/ g.yi lpags/ rta pho bcas/ yang gnyer chen don 'grub nas gzhung ja 'khor drug gsum/ mdun 'khor ser skya spyi nas/ kha btags/ gos yug wa lpags/ g.yi lpags/ gzig lpags/ mdzo/ rta pho bcas/ dbon po tshe ring bkra shis nas/ kha dar/ gro khal nyi shu/ stobs rtse/ sog chen/ shing spyad sna tshogs/ par dpon las thogs tshul khrims bstan 'dzin nas/ tshogs zangs shin tu che legs dang*/ lcags khro che ba/ 'bras dkar zho gcig rnam rgyal grwa tshang nas lha reg ras dmar yug gsang ras yug gnyis/ a ti bubs/ gos can kha sbrel/ wa lpags/ g.yi lpags/ gzig lpags/ dngul srang gsum/ mdzo/ rta pho bcas/

phur pa chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po nas mdzod btags/ phrug dkar/ ras dkar/ lho ras/ mgo snam ser po gos ldang*/ zhu dag bla ma can nas/ lha dar dkar po/ ting shag dung phreng*/ dngul srang do/ wa/ spyang*/ gsa'/ sram/ gzig rnams kyi lpags pa re/ 'khar tir/ skyogs dkar/ zangs dkar/ du ba ko ṭa gsum/ g.yag 'bri/ mdzo gsum/ rta pho gcig bcas rnam grangs nyer gcig rong po bla ma kun dga' 'byung gnas nas/ lha rdzas/ wa lpags/ gung lpags/ sram lpags/ ras yug mdzo bcas/ mgon bla pa lhun grub ting 'dzin nas lha rdzas/ bar khang 'bo'i nas khal brgya tham pa/ dus 'khor bla ma kun dga' phun tshogs nas lha rdzas/ ling yug gser sbyangs zho gcig wa lpags gsum/ ja 'khor drug gnyis/ nas khal bco lnga/ mar rgya nyer gcig phyag mdzod bla ma shes rab bzang po nas/ gser sbyangs srang do/ gser shog che gra brgya phon brgya dang lnga bcu/ gos yug dar bcas/ bla ma rab dkar lhun grub nas/ kha dar/ gser sbyangs zho gang*/ dngul srang lnga/ mdzo gnyis/ g.yag gcig rta pho/ bla mtshan kun dga' chos bzang nas lha gos/ ras cha/ ja sbag gnyis/ mar rgya brgya nyer gcig g.yag mgron gnyer kun dga' bstan skyong gis/ lha reg ling yug gser sbyangs zho gcig mar brgya drug cu/ ja 'khor drug gcig g.yag mdzo bcas/ gnyer pa rin chen chos dar gyis lha dar/ dngul bal dong brgyas nyos pa'i gser shog che gra spus legs phon brgya dang bcu/ gsol dpon kun dga' chos dar gyis dar kha ja 'khor drug gcig g.yag gcig gnyer chen kun dga' bsod nams kyis lha reg sman tsa/ dar kha/ la dkar gsum yug de/ dngul bal dong lnga bcu tham pa bcas/ gnyer kun dga' blo chen gyis kha dar/ ja 'khor drug gcig tshong dpon kun dga' rgya mtshos kha dar/ gser sbyangs srang gang*/ drung yig shākya chos 'phel gyi dar/ gser sbyangs skar lnga/ ja sbag gnyis/ dpon gnyer tshul khrims bzang pos dar kha/ gser zho gang*/ wa/ gling mgo zi khang gsar zhabs drung bsod nams bstan 'dzin nas/

lha dar/ wa lpags/ ras yug mdzo bzang ba/ rta bzang ba bcas/ rdzogs chen bla brang nas thud she dang*/ sha nag bubs/ rgya rong bla brang nas dar kha/ ja sbag wa/ glang nag sprul skus dar kha/ ja 'khor drug gsum bcas/ rab brtan chos rje nas/ gtsug lag khang du mdzod btags spus legs kyi 'phan cha gcig lha dar/ ling yug gnyis/ sman yug ras yug gnyis/ rgya dngul srang nyer lnga/ mgo snam ser po kha do/ wa/ sbre/ gung*/ spyang*/ gzig rnams kyi pags pa re/ rta pho bcas dang*/ yang thab gsos la ja 'khor drug gnyis/ chur ba khal bdun/ mar rgya sum cu/ lha shing gyang rdo zhal mgar sogs la ja chang thud bcas lan gnyis/ gla zan mang mar chur 'gyed bcas dang*/ gnyer pa bkra shis rgya mtshos dar kha/ mdzo/ bdag gyis bla ma sangs rgyas dpal 'byor gyis/ dar/ ras yug wa lpags/ spyang lpags/ ja 'khor drug gcig mdzo dang rta pho bcas/ bdag gyis chos rje dkon mchog phun tshogs nas/ lha dar/ ras yug wa lpags/ spyang lpags/ ja 'khor drug mdzo/ rta dang*/ yang bdag gyis khag gnyis kyi lha shing rdo gyang mgar zhal sogs las tshan la ja thud dang*/ thab gsos la lha rdzas/ ras yug ling yug wa lpags/ mar rgya nyi shu/ ja 'khor drug gnyis/ sha nag bubs gnyis/ thar rtse chos rjes/ dar kha ras yug wa lpags/ gsa' lpags/ rta pho/ chos rje bsod nams grags pa'i dgongs rdzogs su/ dar kha tib dkar/ zo khra/ 'ba' skyogs/ zangs dkar bcas gtan bzhag phul/ 'dzin sbam mdzangs bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzod btags/ gro khal lnga bcu/ dus mchod rten la dngul srang lnga bcu'i mal gyi sa khang zhing*/ 'dam thog chos rje rin chen grags pas lha dar/ gzig lpags/ mdzo bcas/ bse bla ma byams pa bstan 'dzin gyis/ gser sbyangs srang gang dang zho gsum/ g.yag ze dgon pas dar kha/ ja sbag wa lpags/ gdong thog dbon po sangs rgyas rin chen gyis nas khal brgya/ gad thog dpon phun tshogs dang*/ a khra ming lcam nas dar kha/ ja 'khor drug mar rgya sum cu/

lha ru dpon lhun grub khu tsha bcas nas ja 'khor drug mar rgya sum cu/ sha dkar gnyis/ dpon mo bo di nas mar rgya nyer lnga/ dme shod dpon karma nas kha btags/ g.yi lpags/ ja 'khor drug gcig mar rgya lnga bcu/ nas khal bzhi bcu bcas/ de ltar zhal 'debs byung ba rnams kyang chud zos su ma song bar rten bzheng 'di dag gi rgyu rkyen du btang nas/ rgyu sbyor 'brel thogs kun kyang tshogs bsags kyi 'bras bu rgyal ba'i sku mchog thob pa'i smon lam lhan cig tu btab pa'i skal ba bzang po la legs par sbyar ro// gnyis pa rab gnas ji ltar byas pa la gnyis te/ dgos pa dang cho ga'i dngos gzhi gnyis las/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa la// byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na// de las bkra mi shis 'byung zhing*// ji srid mchod pa der mi 'os// zhes 'byung ba ltar rten bzhengs grub nas rab tu gnas pa'i cho gas byin gyis brlabs par ma byas par ring du gnas na/ de la bgegs 'jug pa sogs kyis mi 'dod pa bskyed pa dang de srid du mchod par bya ba'i 'os su mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de'ang don dam par de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku ni 'khor 'das kun gyi khyab bdag tu bzhugs pa las/ nam yang 'gro dbang med pa'i phyir rab tu gnas pa bgyir med mod/ kun rdzob tu rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pa byas pa la brten nas byin gyis brlabs par byar yod cing de'i rten 'brel gyi mthus chos kyi bshad sgrub dar rgyas su 'byung ba dang*/ sems can gyi khams su'ang dwang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pas mchod kyin gsol ba gdab pa sogs kyis 'di phyi kun du phan bde gzhal du med pa 'byung ste/ de nyid las/ sangs rgyas kun na rab tu bzhugs// rab tu gnas pa gang na'ang med// kun du mkha' ltar gnas pa la// cig shos ci ni rab tu brtag /'jig rten kun rdzob la brten nas// rab tu gnas pa rab tu brtag

/ces 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni cho ga dngos la/ rje ngor chen gyis/ rab gnas rten dang slob dpon dus dang gnas// yo byad cho ga bzang po rnam pa drug /ces gsungs pa ltar bzang po drug ldan gyi sgo nas rab tu gnas par bgyid pa la/ dang po ni/ gong du smos pa'i rten de dag kyang gong du bshad pa'i tshad de dag gi khong nas dbyung ba la goms 'dris yod pa 'ga' zhig gis kha ta dang bzo bcos byed pas ha lam tshad ldan du yod pa ni rten bzang po'o// gnyis pa ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ slob dpon de nyid bcu shes shing*// mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan// phyag rgya sngags dang cho ga shes// las rnams kun la mkhas pas so// zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang zhing*/ bye brag phyi nyan thos kyi sde snod las bshad pa'i bslab gzhi nyes med kyi sdom par gnas shing*/ nang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sde snod nas bshad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya chen po spyad pa dang*/ gsang bar rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chen po rdo rje 'chang rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal snga nas kyis gtso bor bzhugs pa'i sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun nyer lnga tsam 'dus pa rnams ni slob dpon bzang po'o// gsum pa ni/ 'dir rten bzhengs nas ring du ma 'gyang bar shis pa'i lung gtsor bzung nas/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor dang ni rab gnas pa// yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya// gza' dang skar ma 'dzom gyur na// mar ngo la yang nyes pa med// ces 'byung ba'i rab gnas kyi dus su dgos pa'i gza' skar 'dzom pa'i tshe ste/ de'ang kun 'dzin gnam lo'i ri klung thams cad gser gyi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i 'bras ldan gyi khrums kyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa/ 'od zer bdun pa dang dal ba'i lha ldan dga' ma 'dzom pa'i dpal gyi be'u'i 'phrod sbyor yod pa'i nyin tshes dge bar sta gon gyi mgo brtsams nas nyin lnga par mdza' lha'i grogs pos gdengs can dga' mar rtsen pa'i nyin rab gnas rjes ma'i dngos gzhi'i cho ga grub par byas pa ni dus bzang po'o// bzhi pa ni/

gzhung rin chen 'bar ba las/ gnas ni yid 'od 'du 'dzi sogs// skyon med rnam mdzes bla khab can// zhes bshad pa dang mthun par gong du bstan pa'i dge mtshan dang*/ bkra shis rtags kyis kun nas sgeg pa gang yin pa de ni gnas bzang po'o// lnga pa ni/ 'phan gdugs bla bre sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gnas der dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub mchod kyi sta gon dngos gzhir dgos pa'i yo byad dang*/ rab gnas kyi sta gon dang dngos gzhir dgos pa'i mchod rdzas ma tshang ba med pa bzang zhing gya nom par bshams pa ni yo byad bzang po'o// drug pa ni/ yang rgyud las/ cho ga dag dang ldan pas bya// cho ga dman pas mi bya ste// rab gnas rtag par mi shis 'gyur// 'jig rten 'di ni sdug bsngal la// 'jig rten pha rol 'jigs pa che// zhes bshad pa ltar/ bcom ldan 'das kyis theg chen gyi gzhung dang gsang chen rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i gseb tshag rnams nas mang du bstan pa dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud du rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud logs su bstan pa rnams/ 'phags bod kyi skyes chen bstan pa'i snang byed chen por gyur pa rnams kyis rgya cher bkral ba'i dgongs don rnams ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras rnams kyis zhal lung dri ma med pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa dpal kye rdo rje la brten pa'i rab gnas cho ga dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las 'byung ba ltar lag len phra mo tshun chad ma nor bar bsgrubs pa ni cho ga bzang po ste/ de ltar bzang po drug ldan gyi cho gas thog ma'i rab gnas dang*/ slar yang bar mtha' kun du rab gnas kyi cho ga lan mang du bsgrubs te/ mdor na gong du smos pa'i rten gsum gyi tshogs de dag gi sku'i rdul phran re re'i gong yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams kyi rang bzhin du bsgrubs nas/ legs bris dbang po bcas pa'i skye dgu ma lus pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing bla na med par mnga' gsol nas/

bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po yon mchod sku 'khor du bcas pa nas rten la snyan shal dang legs gsol mdun 'jog dang bkra shis kyi cho gas mtha' brgyan cing dga' ston bzang po la longs su spyad pa ni rten bzheng gi bgyi ba mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ rten la phyag mchod ri mor bgyis pa'i phan yon yang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir// mthun ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi// rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir// 'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid// ces gsungs pa ltar dkon mchog gsum dang mtshungs pa'i skyabs kyi dam pa ni bskal pa brgya la man yang med pa'i phyir dang*/ nyes pa bag la nyal bcas yongs su spangs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'gro ba ma lus pa 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob par nus pa'i phyir dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyis sgras dben pa ni mtha' 'khob yin la/ des na dkon mchog gsum gyis brgyan pa ni 'jig rten dam pa'i snying po dang ldan pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du mchog gi go 'phang nas 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir skyabs kyi mchog nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gang gi phyir na de dag la skyabs su song zhing byang chub bar gyi rten dang*/ gling dang*/ dpung gnyen du bzung ba rnams kyis de dag gi bzhugs gnas gtsug lag khang bzheng ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bskrun pa dang*/ de dag la mchod cing rjed pa dang*/ bkur stir bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po gzhal du ci zhig yod de/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa las/ mi rnams gang dag rgyal ba'i gtsang khang byed// de dag 'gro ba rnams su 'khor ba na// lha dbang gnas 'dra'i khang khyim 'od 'bar ba// dus tshigs kun du bde ldan thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ gcer bu kun dga' rwa ba sogs// brtsig pa sdig pa'i rgyu zhes zer// thams cad mkhyen pa khyod nyid ni// de nyid bsod nams rgyu zhes gsungs// zhes 'byung ba ltar dri'i gtsang khang sogs byed pa 'gog pa ni/

mur 'dug gcer bu pa sogs kyi rjes 'brangs yin la/ rang re ston mchog nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bka' don rjes su bsgrub par 'dod pas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dang brten pa'i tshogs bskrun pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs chen por 'gyur ba'i rgyu ste/ phal po che las/ rigs par ldan pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la// sbyor ba skyo ba med par mchod byas na// de dag bdud bzhi'i lam la rab 'das nas// byang chub bla med myur du reg par 'gyur// zhes so// de bas na bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnams las rten gsum bzhengs pa'i phan yon gyi bsngags pa rgya cher 'byung mod/ 'dir skal ba dang ldan pa rnams yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir mdo tsam gleng na/ khyad par bskal pa dpag tu med pa nas bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan gyis mngon par bkras pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gser la sogs pa rin po che nas/ rdo shing 'jim pa'i rnam pa can yan chad du 'bur du bzhengs pa dang ris su bris pa'i legs byas kyi phung po thob pa ni/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ sangs rgyas sku gzugs shin tu mdzes pa dag /rin chen byi dor legs par byas pa yang*// blta na sdug cing shin tu mdzes pa gyis// ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di thob// de bzhin gser dag dang ni dngul dag dang*// tsandan gyis ni sku gzugs bzang po dag /mdzes shing shin tu blta na sdug pa gyis// ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di thob// 'jim pa dang ni de bzhin rdo ba dang*// shing la ri mor byas pa'i sku gzugs kyang*// mdzes shing shin tu blta na sdug pa gyis// ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di thob// ces dang*/ bsgrub par dka' ba'i bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po'ang rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bskrun pa las 'thob par 'gyur ba yang*/

dam pa'i chos padma dkar po las/ la las de ni rin chen sna bdun dang*// la las de bzhin zangs dang 'khar ba las// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas pa// de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// ro nye dang ni lcags sam sa yang rung*// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas te// blta na sdug pa'i 'jim pa'i las byed bcug /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// gang gis rtsig ngos gzugs kyi ri mo dag /bsod nams brgya mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// bdag gis bris sam 'dri ru bcug kyang rung*// de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes sogs rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel rnams las rgya cher 'byung ba las shes par bya'o// de bzhin du gsung rten dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam bris pa'i bsod nams ni/ ji skad du/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang*// sgrib pa kun sel dam pa'i chos// zhes dam pa'i chos ni sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa mthar 'byin cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bar 'thob par byed pa'i rgyus gtso bo ste/ sgo mtha' yas par sgrub pa'i gzungs las/ mdo sde thos nas rjes su yi rang ste// yi ger bris dang gzung dang bklags pa yi// bsod nams chu bo ji tsam bskyed pa ni// sems can kun gyis shes par yongs mi nus// de ni tshe rabs kun du rgyal ba mthong*// de dag la yang dad pa bsam yas rnyed// mdo sde zab mo'i tshul yang shes par 'gyur// de ni myur du byang chub mchog 'tshang rgya// bla med byang chub ma reg bar du yang*// de ni ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes dang*// gzungs rnams dang ni gzugs dang longs spyod dang*// sangs rgyas mthong las nyams par yang mi 'gyur// zhes sogs dang gzhan yang bshad pa dang sgrub pa sogs kyi phan yon mang du 'byung ba yang ma spros so// thugs kyi rten ni mchod rten dang phyag mtshan te/

spyir mchod rten zhes pa rten gsum ga la 'jug mod/ 'dir chos kyi sku'i rten mchod rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus par/ thub dbang mchod rten byed pa'i mi rnams ni// mya ngan yongs med kun du brtan pa dang*// longs spyod mchog dang rin chen mdzod mang ldan// dgra yi tshogs rnams kyang ni thub par 'gyur// rgyal ba'i mchod rten srog shing phul ba yis// chos dang rjes mthun chos la sgrub pa dang*// tshul khrims mchog dang bzod pa'i mchog dang ldan// 'jig rten dag na don kun 'grub par 'gyur// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung yang 'dir mtshon tsam las ma smos so// mdor na rten gsum gyi tshogs 'di dag phyi dbyibs tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs shing*/ nang gzungs dang ring bsrel byin rlabs rten srid na dkon pa'i tshogs kyis phyur bur gtams shing*/ thams cad du rab tu gnas pa'i cho gas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan bkod pa rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing khams kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa 'di dag la/ su gang dag gis mthong ba'i chos dang slad ma'i yang 'byung gi skye ba mchog dngos grub pa'i bar gyi mngon par 'dod pa'i don gang yang gsol ba btab na re ba'i shing rta 'dod pa'i 'bras bu de dang de dag gis mngon par 'gengs pa dang*/ lha dang mi'i yul gyi 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad gya nom pa dag gis mdun bdar te phul ba dang*/ dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag gi phreng ba brtsegs pa bgyis pa la sogs bkur sti ri mor gang byas pa de bzhin gshegs pa nyid 'jig rten du mngon sum byon pa la phyag mchod sogs byas pa dang khyad par med pa'i bsod nams kyi skal ba bzang po la sbyor ba nges pa ni/ mdo sde mya ngan las 'das par/ dga' bo gal te skyes bu zhig gis dad pa'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung phyed dam/

bzhi cha gcig gam/ drug cha'am/ brgya'i cha'am/ stong gi cha'am/ khri'i cha'am/ gaṅgā klung gi bye ma'i cha gcig nas chung ngu na yungs 'bru tsam gcig la dad pa'i sems kyis bsti stang dang bcas rim gro dang bcas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byed pa dang sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa la bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na/ skyes bu de gnyis kyi bsod nams ni thams cad du khyad par med par mnyam ste tshad med dpag tu med do// zhes dang*/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa las/ su dag dkon mchog gsum la me tog dang*// 'bras bu gser thog byung ba 'bul byed pa// de dag 'gro ba rnams su 'khor ba na// ro mchog kun thob mi brdzi stobs dang ldan// zhes sogs rgya cher bstan pa'i phyir ro// khyad par rten 'di dag la phyogs bcu mu med zhing gi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa 'dus pa'i rang bzhin du shes shing gus pa'i sems kyis bkur sti dang bskor ba byas pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po gal te gzugs kyi rnam par grub na cha dang grangs su byar ci zhig yod de/ lung bzhi las/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dwang bas// sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni gom 'dor na// 'dzam bu chu bo gser gyi srang tshad ni// stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min// zhes dang*/ spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdor/ mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni// tshe rabs dag ni thams cad du// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// srin po rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur// ngas ni gang dag bstan pa yi// mi khom brgyad po de dag spong*// sangs rgyas 'byung ba rab mdzes pa// mnyes par byed 'di dal bar gcig /mdog ldan gzugs ni phun sum tshogs// mtshan gyis legs par brgyan pa dang*// mthu dang stobs dang ldan par 'gyur// zhes sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad spong ba dang*/ dal ba'i rten thob pa dang*/

'jig rten na lha mi la sogs pa'i stobs 'byor ldan pa'i 'gro ba kun gyis mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba nas/ mthar thug mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pa'i rgyal ba'i sku thob par 'gyur ba'i bar gyi phan yon rgya cher bstan pa rnams kyis yid kyi dbang po dge ba'i lam du drangs pa'i legs par 'dod pa dag gis phyag dang bskor ba bgyid pa la shin tu 'bad par bya ba las lhag pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus la snying po blang ba'i thabs ci zhig yod/ des na rten 'di dag la bskor ba byas pa'i grangs tshad ci tsam la 'bum ther sogs bsags pa'i grangs rtsis kyis gtan la 'bebs na gtso bo bskal pa bzang po'i rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya thub pa'i sku brnyan 'di nyid la bsags pa'i dbang du byas na/ gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol rwa ba dang bcas pa nang tshud kyi dbang du bskor ba gtso bo bskal pa bzang po'i rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya thub pa'i sku brnyan gyi pad gdan la skor tshad blangs pas gtsug lag dngos gzhi la bskor ba sum stong brgyad brgya bsags pas/ 'bum phrag gcig dang drug brgya 'gro nges pa dang*/ nang gsel du zhar byung rten gzhan che phra gang dag bzhugs pa rnams la bskor ba 'bum phrag mang po dus gcig la 'gro bar som nyi cung zad kyang bya mi dgos so// de lta bas na nam 'chi nges med chu bur lta bu'i lus rten mi rtag cing 'jigs pa rang rang gi pha ma gnyen 'brel yul mi rgyal khams kyi 'gro ba phal cher sngar gyis na med pa mi rtag pa kho na'i dbang du song ba dran par byas nas/ rang re rnams kyang de 'dra'i tshul las ma 'das par shes par byas nas tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ de'i bslab bya de dag gi rten gsum la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ phyag mchod bskor ba byas pa'i phan yon ji skad bshad pa rnams yid ches pa'i gnas su bzung nas/

phyag mchod bskor ba sogs la brtson pas dal 'byor la snying po longs nges re mdzod cig ces kun la thal mo sbyar te zhu ba lags so// smras pa/ rab gnas bzang drug cho gas rten gsum rnams// cha shas rer yang rgyal ba'i rab 'byams zhing*// byin gyis brlabs 'dir phyag mchod bskor ba byas// bsod nams phung pos nam mkha'i mtha' yang 'gongs// zhes yid lhung lha rgyal srang gi chos sde srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba las/ rab tu gnas pas byin brlabs phan yon bcas pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// //lnga pa mjug dge ba bsngo ba la/ bsngo ba'i rnam gzhag dang*/ bsngo ba dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de ltar rten gsum bskrun pa la gus pa'i sems bskyed pa/ rgyu rdzas kyi dngos po gtang ba/ sbyor ba brtson 'grus brtsams pa rnams la bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob ste/ de'i nang nas kyang*/ ji skad du/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// zhes 'byung ba ltar 'dir sbyin pa bzhi ga tshang bas bsgrubs dgos pa'i tshul yang*/ gtso bor zang zing sbyin pas las byed pa thams cad bsdus nas so sor 'dod pa'i dngos pos tshim par byed dgos pa dang*/ rang gzhan las byed pa dang bcas pa thams cad sgo gsum dka' tshegs chen pos bsgrub pa'i tshe/ 'grub mi 'grub snyam pa'i dogs pa skye ba na'ang mkhan chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid can nas mchog gsum srung mar bcas pa'i thugs rjer bskul bas gegs med 'grub pa'i dbugs dbyung stsal ba ni mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ sngon chad dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs lam zhugs pa rnams tshul 'di la brtson pa bskyed na rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa la sogs pa'i phan par gdams pa ni chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ rten bzheng pa la sogs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba la ma zhugs pa rnams kyang tshul 'di bsgrub tu bcug pas las byed rgyu rdzas kyi 'brel thogs bcas pa la dge ba'i sa bon sog pa'i phan 'dogs chen po 'byung ba ni byams pa'i sbyin pa nyid do// de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs pa de'i bsod nams bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur yongs su bsngo bas rgyas gdab dgos te/

de ltar min na khong khro drag po skyes pa la sogs pas chud 'dza' ba dang*/ gnas skabs kyi bde 'byor cung zad re myang ba tsam gyis 'dzad par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod de/ ji skad du/ sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs// legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang*// khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na dge ba'i rtsa ba gang byas thams cad yongs bsngo dam pas bsgyur dgos/ de'ang 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba kho na ma zad rang gzhan 'brel thogs kun gyis tshe rabs du ma nas bsags pa'i dge bas mtshon/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i dge tshogs thams cad kyang bsngo rung ste/ phal po che las/ tha dad phyogs nas chu klung mang po dag /rgya mtsho cher 'bab ro gcig gyur pa ltar// tha dad phyogs nas dge ba bsags byas pa// byang chub bsngos pa rnams kyang ro gcig 'gyur// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba de'ang bla na med pa'i byang chub las gzhan pa'i skabs gsum dbang po lta bu'am/ ltos 'phye chen po dang*/ stong 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ khams kyi rgyal phran nam/ 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa thos sgrog dang rang rgyal la sogs pa'i rgyur bsngor mi btub ste/ rgyan las/ khams gsum gtogs pa ma yin dang*// zhes dang*/ rgyal pa'i yum las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ma gtogs pa nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar bsngo ba'i tshul yang*/ tha snyad du ji ltar bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad 'gro ba kun dang thun mong du byas te bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas te don dam par chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i shes rab kyi dbang pos dpyad ngor/ bsngo bya'i dngos po dang*/ bsngo ba'i bsam pa dang*/ bsngo ba'i yul te 'khor gsum yongs su dag par shes pas bsngo te/

mdo sde rgyan las/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// phyin ci ma logs mtshan nyid do// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ des na mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te// rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas// de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med// chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir te/ de dag gis bsngo ba'i rnam par bzhag pa nyung zad sngon du btang nas gnyis pa ni/ 'dir dpal ldan daṇḍi pa'i gzhung las 'phos pa'i bsngo ba tshigs su bcad pa cung zad brjod pa 'di lta ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan bkod pa'i sprin// phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i mu dang mnyam song ba'i// 'gro 'dul chos kyi char chen rtag 'jo ba// dus gsum gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// stong nyid snying rje'i spyod pas gzhan don gyi// khur chen khyer la mi ngal rgyal ba'i sras// thos sgrogs dgra bcom rkyen rtogs rgyal ba'i bka'// de 'dzin skyong ba'i dam can srung mar bcas// 'di na byang chub spyod pa gang spyad pa'i// dge tshogs srid zhi'i mtha' kun thams cad mkhyen// mngon par 'grub phyir yongs bsngo smin pa'i lam// snying pos lci ba'i mthun 'gyur dbyangs su longs// deng 'dir yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po yis// dad dga'i 'brel thogs kyis mtshon sems can khams// phan gdags bstan pa'i bshad sgrub rgyas bya'i phyir// rten gsum dge 'dun 'du ba'i chos sde bskrun// rgyu sbyor las 'brel gang yod dge ba dang*// 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das bsod nams tshogs// gang dag bsags pa che mchog thams cad kyis// bsngags pa'i rjes su bdag gis bsngo bgyi'o// gang zhig nges par thob na dus kyi mthas// skad cig rer yang grangs med lus can tshogs// sdug bsngal mtha' med chu gter las bsgral nas// bde rab ster ba'i mgon po mngon gyur cig

/de gsung rno mtshon reg bya mi ldan zhing*// khro gnyer mche ba'i g.yogs kyang mi phye bar// skye ba'i phreng bsags sgrib gsum bag chags bcas// mthar byed bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dar gyur cig /shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung gi chad// 'jal byed mkhyen rab rmad byung srang gi mda'// ma 'khyog drang por bkod pa'i lung rigs kyis// 'gal 'brel smra ba'i rgyal po sa skya pa// de bstan yid ches sum ldan snang ba'i gter// bcu gnyis khyim du rgyu dang 'dab stong chal// bzhad phyir mi rgyu na yang khams gsum gyi// mi shes rmongs pa gcod gang rgyal gyur cig /mkhas btsun grub par rlom 'ga' stobs bcu pa'i// tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i bsngags pa'i yul thob na// thub pa'i rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang po yi// che ba'i rtogs brjod rjes su rkang pa 'jog /smra mchog de dag rnams kyis bzhed pa'i gzhung*// 'dzin 'chang gsal bar byed pa'i dpal gyi mgur// gzengs su mngon par mtho bas srid pa'i khongs// dam pa'i snying pos lci bar byed gyur cig /mkhyen brtse nus pa rmad du byung ngo zhes// bsngags pa 'di ci lha mchog ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng*// kuṃn dgaṃ'i dpal ster bloṃ groṃs che ldan zol// brdzus pa gang de bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /de sras mched dag gsang gsum yon tan gyi// bkod pa dpag yas phrin las ring 'gro ba// tshe dpag med mgon sku gsum bkod pa bzhin// 'dzam gling yongs khyab bskal par 'tsho gzhes shog /bcom ldan rinaṃ cheṃn 'byung ldan sbyin pa bzhis// sems can re ba ma khengs de srid du// miṃ 'gyuraṃ gdan lnga brtsegs pa'i khri 'phang cher// mi shigs sku yi rgyalaṃ mtshanaṃ brtan gyur cig /de dag spyod rjes sgrub pa'i ngur smrig 'chang*// chos spyod dge ba rnam bcu lhur len pa// gur gum nags klung g.yo bas 'dzam gling khongs// yongs su khengs pa skyes ltar rgyas gyur cig

/legs bris dbang po 'gugs pa'i las ma brtsams// rdzogs ldan sa spyod slar yang lhags min par// bloṃ groṃs dkyel che dge bcu'i bka' khrims kyis// rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i gos can yangs khyab brling gyur cig /ljongs kyi thig le 'dis mtshon 'jig rten khams// snyigs ma'i dug chus cher myos 'thab rtsod dmag /lus stobs bde ba 'tsho srog dbrog pa'i dgra// nad yams bkres rngabs rgud pa 'byung ma gyur// bde dga' 'byor pa'i chu gter rgyas pa'i klong*// gangs can skye 'gro'i 'khor lo'i yan lag rnams// phan tshun mdza' gcugs byams pa'i ming nas 'bod// dge bcur brtson pa'i 'phur lding bsgyur bar shog /dkar phyogs dgyes pa'i lha rnams sprin gyi bcud// zil dngar 'bebs la rab dga' nor 'dzin mas// lo 'dab sdong bu 'bras bu'i dga' ston la// yid can mtha' dag mgron du gnyer gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song bdag cag kyang*// dal 'byor rten ldan tshulaṃ khrimaṃs bslab pas gtsang*// bcu phrag rig pa'i rinaṃ cheṃn 'od stong gis// 'gro blo'i 'dab stong 'grol blo'i byed por shog /rnam dkar dkar min las kyi rgyu 'bras lung*// legs gsungs bslus pa'i gtam ni chos la med// bden pa de yis bzang spyod smon pa'i lam// smras don snying pos dben par ma gyur cig /ces so// smras pa/ 'dir 'bad kyis mtshon 'khor 'das dge ba'i tshogs// gcig tu bsdoms pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur// 'khor gsum dmigs bral sgyu ma'i rtse 'jo ltar// yongs bsngo mkhas pa'i rjes snyed bgyid zin to// zhes yid lhung lha rgyal srang gi chos sde srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba las/ mjug dge ba yongs su bsngo ba'i skabs te lnga pa'o//

//slar yang 'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas gang dag mtshan gyi yi ge'i rnga// su zhig thos pa 'dzin pa'i dpyad du sim tsam ngan 'gro 'khor ba'i 'jigs skyob na// de dag sku brnyan cha shas rer yang rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing rdzogs pa// mngon sum lta byed dbang por shar dang khyad par med pa'i tshul 'di bskrun// zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa'i snang byed sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams dang*// kun dga' bzang zhes mi 'gyur phreng bsgrags 'gro ba legs pa'i gnas bkri ba// rnam gnyis bstan pa'i rjes 'jug chos spyod rnam bcu mgrin 'jo dge 'dun tshogs// gur gum rgyas pa'i dga' tshal co 'dri'i bskal par 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang*// khang pa khang phran dga' ldan lha gnas sa la 'phos 'dri bkod legs khrod// lung rigs thos bsam bshad pa'i glur 'jo rim gnyis bsgom bzlas rnal 'byor par// srid gsum 'byung po dga' dang dad pas dgeṃ legaṃs tshogs bsags mchod pa'i sprin// rgyun chags spro ba kun nas yongs 'du'i bsod nams mchod sdong gsar pa bgyis// gangs ldan lhun por slar yang zla 'od gsar pas bklubs pa'i mdzes sdug bzhin// 'khon ston ngag dbang kun blo rjes pa'i 'phrin yig bkra shis chos dung bcas// 'dus tshogs bye bas klog spong 'khor lo bskal par rgyas dang sa skyong gi /bstan srid 'gro khams bde legs cher rgyas phrin las bka' yi srung mar bsgos// gang phyir thar pa'i gling 'dir 'jug dang zhugs nas dge chos spyad pa dang*// rten gsum dge 'dun tshogs su mchod 'bul bsnyen bkur stob byed sbyin pa'i bdag /ring 'tsho'i tshe dang bsod nams mnga' 'byor dge chos rnams ni gaṅgā'i klung*// 'od srungs byin dang sprin dus chu gter dkar phyogs zla bzhin nges par 'phel// mkhan chen bstan pa'i snang byed mchog gi rnam thar rin chen 'byung gnas gang*// dgos pa cher dgongs lhun po'i srub shing nor rgyas bu yi srub thag brten// gzhan phan snying stobs lha dbang tshogs kyis bsrubs skyes chos sde mkha'i rna ba// skal bzang skye bo'i dpal mgrin ral rtser spud pa'i tshul mchid de tsam mo// bha gi ra thas mjug pa bcu pa'i zhabs bsil brngubs pa'i rgyun chen skyugs// 'dir bdag 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das dus gsum dge ba'i chu klung 'bebs// snga mas rang phyogs lha bu'i ched gnyer kho bos gzhan don byang chub phyir// gnas skabs spyi dang bye brag dam chos
